normalization_plan.reason: The sender parameter is only consumed by the _transfer subtraction operation and its hook call, so it collapses into that unsafe arithmetic node.
The recipient parameter exists solely to index the balance addition inside _transfer.
The amount parameter is used exclusively in the sender balance subtraction of _transfer.
The creator parameter is only used to seed the Blood exemptions inside _HuntTheHunted.
Index g is only used for the bowArr offset computation inside last().
senderBalance is a temporary cache that is immediately consumed by the sender balance subtraction.
currentAllowance is a transient read of _allowances used only within transferFrom and its _approve call.
msgSender is a constructor temporary that is directly stored into the privileged address state variable.
The loop counter q exists only to index the balance division executed in the receive() backdoor.
